p10_b3.ocr: With total pharmacy expenditures reaching an estimated $500 million, organizations must scrutinize factors contributing to these costs. Notably, the table includes metrics such as the percentage of specialty drug spending, which has surged to 20%, and a projected average co-pay of $85 for beneficiaries. These figures underscore the increasing reliance on high-cost specialty medications, which often require tailored management strategies to mitigate financial strain on both payers and patients.

p10_b4.ocr: Furthermore, the table indicates that 90% of prescriptions are filled through preferred pharmacies, emphasizing the importance of network strategies in optimizing cost-effectiveness. As healthcare stakeholders navigate these complexities, understanding the intricacies of pharmacy benefit costs will be essential for developing informed policies that promote both accessibility and fiscal responsibility in the healthcare system.
